title: Strict normal crossings boundary predicate
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $H\subset X$ a closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion]. It is a strict normal crossings boundary if its ideal is an effective Cartier ideal [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal] and radical, so $H$ is reduced [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction], and there are finitely many pairwise distinct integral closed subschemes $C_i\subset X$ [def-pc-integral-scheme] with regular underlying schemes [def-weil-regular-scheme], whose supports have union $|H|$, such that for every subset $J$ of the finite index set the scheme-theoretic intersection $C_J=\bigcap_{i\in J}C_i$ is regular and at every $z\in C_J$, $\dim\mathcal O_{X,z}=\dim\mathcal O_{C_J,z}+|J|$, using Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. An empty intersection scheme satisfies the condition vacuously. The empty index subset gives $C_\varnothing=X$. The empty family of components represents the empty divisor. On a Noetherian regular scheme these are precisely the reduced irreducible components and the regular-intersection criterion of ILO VIII Remark 4.2.2(i).
